rules: Figures and tables are numbered in one continuous sequence that does not restart at the appendix: the lay summary reprints two body plates as Figures 14 and 15 with their original captions, and both reprint rows are recorded, because the numbering is printed [place.doc_order] [caption.numbering].

Nine of the fifteen figure rows are one printed number over two side-by-side panels; the left panel carries the row and the right panel is excluded as fragment-of-other, which keeps family_counts keyed on printed numbers rather than on image objects [geometry.panel_count] [place.doc_order].
Table captions sit above their grids and figure captions below their artwork, without exception across the twenty rows [caption.position].

Every figure is announced by adjacency, not by number: Figures 1 to 13 are never cited by number anywhere in the body, while Tables 1 to 4 are each cited once, and the only numbered figure citations are the two figure 15a references plus the parenthetical (figure 14) in the lay summary [mention.count] [mention.lead_pattern].

No caption in this paper carries a unit, a variable symbol other than Figure 3's V and H and Figure 9's psi, or a conclusion; the captions are bare noun phrases [caption.units] [caption.variables] [caption.concludes].
Three printed headings were missed by the heading pass (5.2, 5.3 and 6.3), so those section_path items are taken from the printed line instead of the indexed heading [place.section_path].

The five grids split into two rule dialects: the notation and data-source grids use booktabs horizontals, the three numeric grids keep vertical rules beside the stub column or a full box [table.rule_style] [table.merged_cells].
